india.one_line: Investors pour into Indian AI startups as IT firms eye enterprise AI and defence signs AI partnership.

themes.title: Nvidia and Cognizant fund AI startups
themes.text: Nvidia led a $14 million Series B round in Simplismart, valuing it at about $100 million, while Cognizant is negotiating a $300 million investment in Bengaluru‑based Sarvam AI at a $3.5‑4 billion valuation.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs
Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation

themes.title: Indian IT firms target AI profits
themes.text: A research report by Anand Rathi says Indian IT companies can benefit from enterprise AI adoption by offering asset‑light services, avoiding the heavy capital spend of building large AI computing infrastructure, as AI infrastructure costs rise.

stories.headline: Indian IT firms positioned to profit from enterprise AI as infrastructure costs rise

themes.title: Defence ministry partners with Sarvam AI
themes.text: India's Ministry of Defence signed a five‑year MoU with Sarvam AI to develop and deploy AI applications for the Army, Navy and Air Force, covering decision support, target acquisition and data fusion with human oversight retained.

stories.headline: India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
